system.description: You map the precise spatial vector between where you stand and a place you have visited before.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you may bring up to three willing creatures you touch.
outcomes.success: You vanish and reappear at that place.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: You arrive d6 miles off course, somewhere the Dark Master chooses. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
